review: 702.53b-1: setup claimed step upkeep with the untap step still to come, which is not a reachable order; moved to B's cleanup step so A's next untap step is the one observed.

scenarios.title: Transmute discards the card and tutors a card of the same mana value

setup.notes: Dimir Infiltrator has mana value 2. Library is ordered top first.

decisions: A activates transmute of Dimir Infiltrator from hand, paying {1}{U}{B} with Island, Swamp and Forest and discarding it.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A searches the library for a card with mana value 2.

variants.label: match_in_library
variants.expected: Dimir Infiltrator is in A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears (mana value 2) is revealed and moves from the library to A's hand. The library is shuffled.

variants.label: no_match
variants.delta: The library holds Centaur Courser (mana value 3) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Dimir Infiltrator is in A's graveyard. No card has mana value 2, so nothing moves to A's hand. The library is shuffled.

scenarios.title: Transmute can be activated only as a sorcery and only from hand
decisions: A checks whether transmute of Dimir Infiltrator can be activated, with Island, Swamp and Forest available.

variants.label: main_phase_empty_stack
variants.expected: Activating transmute is legal: it is A's main phase, the stack is empty and Dimir Infiltrator is in A's hand.

variants.label: combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Activating transmute is not legal: it is not a main phase.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: B's Shock targeting A is on the stack.
variants.expected: Activating transmute is not legal: the stack is not empty.

variants.label: on_battlefield
variants.delta: Dimir Infiltrator is on A's battlefield instead of in A's hand.
variants.expected: Activating transmute is not legal: the card is not in a hand.

scenarios.title: A transmute land counts as having a non-mana activated ability on the battlefield

setup.notes: It is B's cleanup step; A's turn comes next. A's land is tapped. Tsabo's Web says each land with an activated ability that isn't a mana ability doesn't untap during its controller's untap step. Tolaria West has a mana ability and transmute.

decisions: B's turn ends and A's turn begins; A's untap step happens. Nobody makes a decision.

variants.label: transmute_land
variants.expected: Tolaria West stays tapped: its transmute ability counts as a non-mana activated ability even though it works only in hand.

variants.label: plain_land
variants.delta: A's land is a tapped Island instead of Tolaria West.
variants.expected: Island untaps: it has only a mana ability.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements transmute as an ability that is activatable only from hand. Check that hasNonManaActivatedAbility counts it on the battlefield.
